touches.remove: Turn the switch raise_attached off on its row in Evolution, Mutations: nothing attached is read and the list is gone. To remove it for good revert night 31's raise_attached commit (rouh/raise_attached.py, its lines in rouh/meeting_brief.py, the brief_raise_attached route in rouh/web/brief.py and rouh/project/urls.py, the attached list and raiseAttachedUsed in briefpage.js, this manifest); the attachments field of an event in rouh/google_api/calendar.py stays for Attach to a meeting.
